The checked-in R4/R4B history files and current THO 6.5.0 rendering have the corrected period.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/history searches found no remaining instance of the bad closing parenthesis, and the external terminology publication that now owns the CodeSystem text is also corrected.
